name: dev_mutual_cycle
description: Mutual-cycle demonstration (honest negative result). DESIGN TARGET: 8-CPU cluster, two concurrent trials each requesting a 4-CPU parent PG and a 4-CPU child PG — a textbook mutual wait-for cycle A waits-for B, B waits-for A. EMPIRICAL FINDING: in this simulator parent admission and child placement are atomic within one tick, so a true two-trial mutual cycle CANNOT form. Both trials complete under all three policies (verified empirically). The closely-related real hazard is collateral blocking, demonstrated by the companion fixture dev_collateral_blocking: a self-infeasible nested trial (parent 4 + child 5 = 9 > 8 max capacity) is admitted by the hierarchy-blind baselines and its stuck parent PG blocks a feasible trial's parent, hanging BOTH under FIFO and greedy; deadlock_aware rejects the infeasible trial at admission and the feasible one completes. See docs/CP2_MUTUAL_CYCLE.md for the full analysis.
